name: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Animator's Palate / 1923 / Cabanas
whyItWorks: Pureed peeled butternut squash and warm broth require zero chewing and deliver soothing soluble pectin that calms intestinal transit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or blend completely smooth without crunchy croutons, bacon bits, or pumpkin seed garnishes. Take a Lactaid enzyme if made with heavy dairy cream.
watchOuts: Heavy dairy cream if lactose sensitive
